census.note: iREPA projector is a Stage-1 leftover (F32 convs), not a depth adapter; reported, not analyzed.

embeds.reuse: single banked pair, [0:1] slice / expand-repeat across batch

blueprint.attention: joint self-attention over concat [text;image], full bidirectional, dense, QK-RMSNorm + 3D RoPE, single joint mask
blueprint.block: dual-stream AdaLN-Zero (img_mod/txt_mod SiLU-Linear to 6x dim, LayerNorm no-affine, gated residuals), joint attn, GELU-approx MLPs (12288), final AdaLayerNormContinuous + proj_out
blueprint.timestep: fixed t=499/1000, BF16; text encoder never loaded (precomputed embeds feed all 60 blocks as joint tokens + entry txt_norm/txt_in)

frozen_map.vae_tuned: decoder + post_quant_conv (full weights, not LoRA); encoder absent (frozen)

recompute.full_norms_manual: python3 /tmp/opencode/teacher_anatomy_compute.py  # CPU-only, ~35s; streams 40GB backbone read-only; writes /tmp/opencode/anatomy_raw.json
recompute.note: Routine gate runs header + factor-side legs only (no 54GB load); backbone-relative norms recomputed manually here and banked above.
